headlines.title: Truist Advisory Services Provides Market Commentary on Technology Sector
headlines.line: Truist Advisory Services analysts have commented on the technology sector, noting significant valuation corrections and potential opportunities following recent market volatility.

headlines.title: Scotiabank Receives Industry Awards for AI-Powered Innovation
headlines.line: Scotiabank has been recognized with multiple industry awards for its advancements and innovation in AI-powered financial solutions.

headlines.title: US Commerce Department Expedited H200 China Export Approvals for NVIDIA
headlines.line: The US Commerce Department reportedly accelerated the approval process for NVIDIA's H200 chip exports to China.

headlines.title: Jacobs Selected by Sanofi as EPCM Partner for New Insulin Facility in Germany
headlines.line: Jacobs has been appointed by Sanofi to provide Engineering, Procurement and Construction Management (EPCM) services for a new insulin manufacturing facility in Frankfurt, Germany.

headlines.title: BMO Real Financial Progress Index Reports Holiday Spending Trends
headlines.line: BMO's latest Real Financial Progress Index reveals insights into U.S. consumer holiday spending habits and financial pressures.

headlines.title: Bank of Montreal Demonstrates Quantum Computing Utility in Machine Learning With IBM
headlines.line: Bank of Montreal has showcased the practical application of quantum computing in machine learning through a collaboration with IBM.

headlines.title: Sanofi Receives EU Approval for VaxRabeo Rabies Vaccine
headlines.line: The European Commission has approved Sanofi's next-generation rabies vaccine, VaxRabeo, for use in all age groups.

headlines.title: FDA Approves Sanofi's Infilbray for Type 3 Gaucher Disease
headlines.line: The U.S. Food and Drug Administration has approved Sanofi's Infilbray (venglustat) to treat neurological manifestations of type 3 Gaucher disease.

headlines.title: CIBC Asset Management Announces November 2026 Cash Distributions for CIBC ETFs
headlines.line: CIBC Asset Management Inc. has announced the cash distributions for its exchange-traded funds (ETFs) and the ETF series of its fixed income pools and sustainable investment solutions for November 2026.

headlines.title: German Regulator Investigates Deutsche Bank Over Massive Data Leak
headlines.line: German regulatory authorities have launched an investigation into Deutsche Bank following a significant leak of internal client and company data.

headlines.title: Moody's Projects 2.3% U.S. Economic Growth for 2026
headlines.line: Moody's released a forecast projecting 2.3% growth for the U.S. economy in 2026, with expectations of a slowdown in subsequent years.

headlines.title: Multiple Analysts Adjust Price Targets for Ecolab Inc.
headlines.line: Several financial institutions, including Deutsche Bank, Mizuho Securities, and others, updated their price targets for Ecolab Inc. on November 19, 2026.

headlines.title: Oliver Wyman to Acquire Synpulse
headlines.line: Oliver Wyman, a management consulting business of Marsh & McLennan Companies, Inc., has agreed to acquire technology consulting firm Synpulse.

headlines.title: Google Pledges Local Job Creation for Data Center Support
headlines.line: Google Chief Investment Officer Ruth Porat has committed to creating local jobs in regions where the company is seeking support for new data center projects.

headlines.title: The Allstate Corporation Announces Estimated Catastrophe Losses for October 2026
headlines.line: The Allstate Corporation reported estimated catastrophe losses of $232 million pre-tax, or $184 million after-tax, for the month of October 2026.

**Market summary: 2026-11-19 (prior session 2026-11-18)**

US equities were mixed in the prior session. SPY fell 0.31% and the Dow dropped 1.10%, while QQQ rose 0.39% and the Russell 2000 gained 0.40%. Over five sessions, SPY is down 3.90% and XLK is down 6.05%. Consumer discretionary (XLY, +1.79%) led sectors, while energy (XLE, -3.27%) and health care (XLV, -2.20%) lagged. Gold fell 3.20% and oil (USO) fell 2.94%. Long Treasuries (TLT) rose 0.84%, and VIXY fell 2.90%.

At 13:17 UTC, pre-market indications showed SPY +1.21%, QQQ +2.10% and XLK +2.44%. Many single-stock pre-market moves rest on very thin volume and may not reflect actual trading prices.

Economic data: housing starts came in at 1.309M versus a 1.250M consensus, while building permits fell to 1.295M versus 1.380M. Pending home sales dropped 4.7% against a -2.0% consensus. The EIA reported a crude inventory build of 3.380M versus a 0.400M consensus.
